name: Rudra Sharma
intro: I build software end to end.
APIs and event-driven services, React front-ends,
and the pipeline that ships them.
summary: Software engineer with around a year of experience across two internships, building full-stack products with Java/Spring Boot, Node.js and React. Hands-on with microservices, event-driven systems (Kafka, BullMQ), multi-tenant SaaS, Redis caching, Keycloak/JWT auth, and AWS.

about.lead: I like owning a feature the whole way — schema, service, API, interface, deploy.
about.detail: I've shipped a multi-tenant SaaS ERP serving 45 tenants, an ingestion pipeline that chews through 10M+ listings in under 15 seconds, and full-stack products like DoubtNix where I wrote both the React front-end and the APIs underneath it. The hardest parts usually live behind the API — Spring Boot and Node.js services passing messages through Kafka and BullMQ instead of blocking a request — but I'd rather own the whole path, from the database through to the screen and the Docker/Kubernetes pipeline that deploys it.
